description: 4 pulse(s) of the crystal in the trainer's hands (600 ms each); the 6 runes close in each pulse (radius 20 -> 8). Variant 4 == first 16 frames of variant 4.
status: DRAFT - not approved by Gary, NOT wired into game code
background: fully transparent (1-bit alpha), palette-only opaque pixels
loop: play ONCE in game (remove after total_ms)
sheet_layout: horizontal strip, frame i at x=i*frame_w

anchor.usage: draw the frame at (hold_x - anchor.x*k, hold_y - anchor.y*k), k = display px per 2x px; hold = the trainer raised-hands point for the current pose frame

emissive: all (all = draw with the ToD lit grade)

hand_anchor.sprite_px: TBD by Character models: the raised-hands point in each player back-sprite raise frame (x, y in sprite px)

foe_anchor.rule: foe sprite visual centre; rune ring radii 34 x 30 px around it

pulse_variants.prefix_rule: variant N is exactly the first 4N frames of variant 4, so code may also play pulse_4 and stop after pulse N
pulse_variants.choose_by_odds: each pulse is one capture check: pulse k plays only if checks 1..k passed. Fail after pulse N -> breakout_<type>; pass all 4 -> lock_bloom. Game dev may instead pick N straight from the odds tier (low 1, mid 2-3, high 4) if the formula changes.
